name: wds_vtab-clevr_closest_object_distance
description: A vision transfer-task derived from CLEVR that measures a model's ability to predict the distance to the closest object in a scene. It evaluates spatial reasoning and distance estimation from rendered images and is used in VTAB-style transfer evaluations. Models are scored on their regression accuracy of predicted distances.
evaluation_method: mean squared error (MSE) / root mean squared error (RMSE)
reputation: A component task within VTAB/CLIP benchmarking suites; used mainly in transfer-learning and robustness studies rather than broad community benchmarks.
